def execute_command(image) -> List[ImagePatch]:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    cars = image_patch.find("black car")
    buildings = image_patch.find("building")
    
    if not cars or not buildings:
        return []
    
    parking_areas = []
    for building in buildings:
        left = building.left
        right = building.right
        top = building.upper
        bottom = building.lower
        
        area_cars = [car for car in cars if car.left >= left and car.right <= right and car.upper >= top and car.lower <= bottom]
        
        if area_cars:
            parking_areas.extend(area_cars)
    
    return parking_areas
